meta.scope: Afghanistan Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA), population, national accounts, CPI, Da Afghanistan Bank institutional core, BOP. Population ~43–45 million. Data environment highly constrained under de facto authorities.

candidates.title: National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office under the de facto authorities, responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics where published.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node. Data continuity, coverage and independence are severely constrained.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Population estimates. Population is approximately 43–45 million; the age structure is very young and rapid population growth continues to pressure per-capita outcomes.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Afghanistan (GDP)
candidates.description: Official and compiled national accounts (GDP). The economy contracted sharply after 2021; recent fiscal years show modest real growth but per-capita outcomes remain under pressure from population growth and structural constraints.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node under constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Price dynamics have moderated relative to the immediate post-2021 shock but remain sensitive to exchange-rate, import and supply conditions.

candidates.title: Da Afghanistan Bank institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial statistics. Publishes exchange rates, inflation references and limited monetary series.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics where available. Remittances, limited formal trade, humanitarian inflows and large informal/unrecorded flows are structural features under current conditions.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node under constrained formal data and large informal flows.

candidates.title: Afghanistan foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from NSIA and DAB sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the NSIA institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, Da Afghanistan Bank institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Afghan research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node. Data quality, coverage and institutional constraints should be carried forward in all subsequent batches.
